full_method_info: /** * Based on the field and value, this limiter modifies the field * and/or the value to something that should be added to the Metadata object. * * If the value is null, no value is set or added. * * Status updates (e.g. write limit reached) can be added directly to the * underlying metadata. * * @param field the metadata field name * @param value the value to add * @param data the metadata map to modify */ void add(String field, String value, Map data);
